concerns.text: FR-002 requires filtering for Type I isotherms, but T060 (Streaming Data Loader) only implements fetching and chunking. There is no task explicitly assigned to perform the 'Filter & Fit' logic (filtering isotherm types) on the streamed data. The plan's Phase 1 step 2 is missing a corresponding task in Phase 7.

SC-001 and SC-003 require reporting '95% confidence intervals' for R² values. Tasks T023 (Evaluation), T024 (Null Model), and T033 (Reduced Model) only mention calculating R², RMSE, and MAE. No task is assigned to implement the bootstrapping or cross-validation variance logic required to generate these confidence intervals.

SC-002 requires the report to 'explicitly identify at least one point of convergence or divergence'. Task T032 generates a 'structured report discussing alignment/divergence' but lacks a specific implementation step to programmatically verify and flag the *existence* of at least one such point, risking a report that discusses alignment without meeting the 'identify at least one' constraint.

FR-001 requires calculating a 'configurable set' of descriptors. T014ba, T014bb, and T014bc implement Kinetic Diameter, Lennard-Jones, and Quadrupole Moment as 'Optional' with logic to 'skip' if data is missing. There is no task to generate a 'missing data' report or trigger a failure state if these critical consensus descriptors are missing, violating the Edge Case requirement to log exclusion reasons or impute.

SC-004 requires the runtime of the 'full pipeline' to be ≤ 4 hours. Task T039c implements a `--mode benchmark` that 'skips the full model training and hyperparameter tuning'. This creates a gap where the benchmark mode (which generates the runtime log) does not measure the 'full pipeline' as defined in the success criterion.

The Edge Cases section requires handling missing pore volume by 'impute... or exclude... logging the exclusion reason'. Task T015 mentions 'handle missing pore volume' but does not specify the method (imputation vs. exclusion) or the logging format, leaving the implementation ambiguous regarding the specific 'logging the exclusion reason' requirement.
